_about: How names and recurring terms are written in this language, for the website now and the game's .po files later. World names (characters, places, coins, canon fish) come from HusbandOutWorld content/i18n/ja/glossary.json: the series wins, so if a spelling there changes, change it here too. Game-only names (fish made for this game) are added here.
rule: Story names in katakana, by sound. This covers coined world terms too: creatures, plants, items, nari gels, factions, guilds, places, ranks and coins (Wood People = ウッドピープル, Fost Stone = フォストストーン, Sapphire = サファイア, balls = ボール). Multi-word names join with ・. Real people (Deovandski, Mitsukiven, Feiourm) and pets named in the afterwords (Peeta, Fluffy, Maddog) stay in Latin letters. Plain words are translated.
